policy.count_note: The approved proposal estimated 64 named dispatcher branches, but the source contains 63 literal cmd == comparisons (command.py:42-953) plus the unhandled else fallthrough (command.py:954-956). The 64th proposal-table row, push_dead_unit, is an engine helper (engine.py:149-171) called from the sell KILL path, not a dispatcher branch. This catalog records source truth: 63 handled entries plus 1 fallthrough entry.
policy.envelope_policy: One command.php POST carries a 64-char hash, a semicolon, and a JSON payload; the verifier checks the envelope documentation fields but does not execute transport.
policy.evidence_policy: source-inspection only; no executed command evidence beyond the four replay-covered commands named in their entries

envelope.pre_dispatch: apply_resources(save, map, resources_changed) runs for every command before dispatch (command.py:40; engine.py:251-271); deltas are client-sent, clamped at zero, and never validated against costs.
envelope.batch_persistence: save_session(USERID) persists the whole player save after the command batch (command.py:32; sessions.py:248-255), including batches that hit only the unhandled fallthrough.
envelope.fallthrough: Unknown cmd names reach the else at command.py:954-956, which logs and returns from do_command while the batch continues and batch persistence still runs.
